records.title: Technology Cyber and Security Summer Internship Programme
records.clearance_check: Pass — no security clearance, citizenship or residency condition stated. Barclays accepts applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship and will provide a skilled worker visa for successful applicants if they meet Home Office eligibility criteria.
records.work_authorisation_risk: Not assessed — owner instruction 2026-10-03: do not discuss visa status for any application.
records.key_gap: The posting requires candidates to be in their penultimate year of university and graduating in 2028. The owner completed their MSc in September 2025, so is a recent graduate rather than a current penultimate-year student. This is a hard eligibility criterion. Not evidenced and not claimed: financial services domain knowledge, penultimate-year student status. Genuinely evidenced: MSc Information Security (Merit), BCA, CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, IT support experience (M365, Active Directory, troubleshooting, endpoint support), Python/PowerShell/SQL, structured problem-solving, customer service, compliance checks, risk assessments.
records.recommendation: Applied per owner instruction. Fit is moderate: the role is a cyber security internship in a bank, and the owner's background is IT support and security. The honest gap is the penultimate-year eligibility requirement — the owner is a recent graduate, not a current student graduating in 2028. The cover letter addresses this directly and makes the case that practical experience would allow meaningful contribution from day one. No clearance or citizenship barrier. Closing date 31 October 2026. Programme duration June to August 2027.
